name: Traefik Proxy
summary: Cloud-native reverse proxy and load balancer: install (static) configuration, routing (dynamic) configuration, Docker/Swarm/Kubernetes/file providers, middlewares, TLS and ACME, observability, migration guides.
coverage: Every English documentation page at tag v3.7.17 (the MkDocs source the doc.traefik.io site is built from), with the reference config files and Kubernetes CRD/RBAC YAML it links to, plus the v3.7.x section of CHANGELOG.md.
gaps: reference/static-configuration/cli-ref.md and env-ref.md are empty files in the source at this tag and were dropped; every install option (with its CLI flag and environment-variable form) is in reference/install-configuration/configuration-options.md.

Traefik Hub (commercial) docs are a separate site and not included; some middleware pages here (jwt, oidc, apikey, waf, ldap, opa, hmac, distributed-ratelimit, oauth2-*) describe Hub-only features and say so.
v3.8 is a release candidate (v3.8.0-rc.1) and not included; v2.11 docs not included.
notes: Latest stable release resolved from GitHub releases on 2026-11-10: v3.7.17 (v3.8.0-rc.1 skipped as a pre-release). Docs are taken from the exact release tag, so the folder is named for it. Build-time includes resolved: 58 `{% include-markdown "includes/..." %}` lines (four shared fragments, incl. a Traefik-for-business promo box) and one MkDocs snippet line (`--8<--`, the Consul KV provider page reuses the HashiCorp Consul page) were inlined; content/includes/ then removed. Removed include-*.md fragments in https/ and operations/ that mkdocs.yml excludes from the site and no page references, plus ref-acme example files only those fragments used, .markdownlint.json files and empty folders.
